blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Select all the numbers that are solutions of two is less than x, which is less than or equal to eight.
blocks.display: Select all the numbers that are solutions of 2 < x ≤ 8.

blocks.text: Two. No: two is not greater than two, so the circle at two is open.
Five. Yes: five is between two and eight.
Eight. Yes: eight is less than or equal to eight, so the circle at eight is closed.
Nine. No: nine is more than eight, outside the graph.
Zero. No: zero is less than two, outside the graph.
Five and eight are solutions. Two is not, because its circle is open, eight is, because its circle is closed, and nine and zero are outside the graph.
